purpose: Cultural sources discovered publicly but not copied into an open corpus without adequate rights or actual Garhwali content

sources.title: Garhwali Folktales podcast
sources.reason: All 66 enclosures exposed by the official RSS feed were archived locally with hashes and source URLs; the listing names the creator and displays an explicit copyright notice.
sources.next_action: Transcribe locally, retain the rights-pending label, and seek consent and an explicit dataset license before redistribution.

sources.title: Garhwali Lokgeet by Govind Chatak
sources.content: Garhwali folk-song collection with Hindi translations
sources.reason: The repository exposes cover and contents files without a verified open license for the book text.
sources.next_action: Contact the rights holder or locate an authorized open edition.

sources.title: Gadwali Lokgeet by Govind Chatak (1956 Internet Archive scan)
sources.content: Volume 1, Laghu Git: a Garhwali folk-song collection with a downloadable Digital Library of India scan
sources.reason: The PDF, OCR text, DjVu XML and metadata were archived; 370 OCR page records were extracted. Internet Archive metadata supplies neither a rights statement nor an open-content license.
sources.next_action: Clean and language-segment locally while retaining provenance and the rights-pending label.

sources.title: Garhwali folk literature critical study by Mohanlal Babulkar (1964)
sources.content: 307-page critical study of Garhwali folk literature, digitized from the University of Michigan
sources.reason: Google Books exposes search snippets rather than a reusable open edition, and no open license was found.
sources.next_action: Locate a licensed edition or obtain permission from the author estate and publisher.

sources.title: Garhwali folk art and folk literature comparative study by Shanti Chaudhary (1994)
sources.content: Hindi research book with Garhwali folk-literature material from an Internet Archive/DLI scan
sources.reason: The PDF, OCR text, DjVu XML and metadata were archived; 298 OCR page records were extracted. Archive metadata supplies no open license or rights statement.
sources.next_action: Clean and language-segment locally while retaining provenance and the rights-pending label.

sources.title: Garhwali idioms and proverbs collection by Pushkar Singh Kandari
sources.reason: Only cover and contents files are public and no open-content license is shown.

sources.title: Himalayan Folklore by E. S. Oakley and Tara Dutt Gairola
sources.content: English translations of Kumaoni and Garhwali heroic ballads and folklore
sources.reason: Public domain in India; likely United States copyright through 2031 after restoration.
sources.next_action: Re-evaluate for international release in 2032 or obtain legal review.

sources.title: Sadei and Garhwali Kavitavali
sources.content: Early modern Garhwali poetry associated with Tara Dutt Gairola
sources.reason: Publication dates, contributor deaths, edition rights, scans, and United States restoration terms require item-level review.
sources.next_action: Locate authoritative first-edition scans and establish contributor-level rights.

sources.title: Garhwali, the historical periodical
sources.content: Garhwali-language and regional periodical published from 1905 into the mid-twentieth century
sources.reason: No complete issue archive with issue-level rights and stable scans was found.
sources.next_action: Search state, university, memorial, and national-library catalogues.

sources.title: StoryWeaver open stories
sources.reason: The checked public source repository contained 18 language directories but no gbm or Garhwali directory.
sources.next_action: Recheck the live catalogue and ingest future Garhwali translations with attribution.

sources.title: Modern Garhwali plays and story collections named by UOU
sources.content: Bibliography and short educational excerpts covering Garhwali theatre, stories and novels
sources.reason: UOU terms do not establish redistribution rights for complete underlying modern works.
sources.next_action: Approach authors, estates, theatre groups, publishers, and UOU for licensed editions.

sources.title: Garhwali Folktales digitalization research chapter
sources.content: Current discussion and bibliography for Garhwali folklore digitization
sources.reason: Public PDF access did not establish an open-content license for training-data extraction.
sources.next_action: Use its bibliography for rights outreach and community collection planning.

sources.title: Kumauni Archives Garhwali-filtered catalogue
sources.content: Searchable non-profit catalogue with a Garhwali language filter and literature, ballad, folk-tale, flora, fauna and linguistic categories
sources.reason: The search interface is public, but item-level files, language identity and reuse rights must be checked before ingestion.
sources.next_action: Enumerate Garhwali-filtered results and rights-audit each item.

sources.title: Lucknow Digital Library Garhwali folk-literature holdings
sources.content: Digitized-book listing includes Garhwali folk-literature research
sources.reason: Search results establish a holding, not an open reuse license or a Garhwali-text payload.
sources.next_action: Open the item record, identify scan access and complete edition-level rights review.

sources.title: Nehru Memorial Museum and Library Garhwali periodical microfilm
sources.content: Catalogue reports Garhwali fortnightly microfilm holdings for 1916–1926, with gaps
sources.reason: The catalogue lists reels rather than openly downloadable issues.
sources.next_action: Request access and digitization metadata from the holding institution.

sources.title: UK Academe Garhwali bird dictionary pages
sources.content: Individual bird terms with Garhwali, Hindi and English examples
sources.reason: The site states all rights reserved; overlapping terms were already recorded from other sources.
sources.next_action: Request a licensed structured export and contributor provenance.

sources.title: Balakrishna D. Dhyani, Garhwali Muhavare Aur Kahavaten
sources.content: Garhwali idioms and proverbs, including Hindi and English explanations for comparison entries
sources.reason: The public page was archived and yielded 99 exact-unique Garhwali records; the page does not state an open-content license.
sources.next_action: Normalize spelling and have a native speaker review boundaries and meanings.
